From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 6 Jun 2029 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up & exec alignment (VP/CTO intro) — Zenlyx

Hi Alex / Samira,

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciated the context on Zenlyx's recommendation pipeline and the latency/cost pressures you mentioned for real-time reranking at scale. Quick recap and proposal to keep momentum: 

- Key takeaways:
  • Primary use case: real-time reranking for recommendations (50–200ms SLO per request)
  • Traffic: ~100 qps steady-state with spikes to 500 qps; sensitive to cost per token
  • Constraints: PCI-adjacent data, want private deployment option and audit logs

Next steps I recommend:
1) Executive alignment call (VP/CTO intro) — short 30 min to confirm success criteria and procurement path so we can unblock a pilot.
2) Technical deep dive/demo — 60 min with your infra & ML engineers to review architecture, integration, and a POC plan.

Our availability next week for the exec intro (PT):
- Tue 6/11: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–16:00 PT
- Wed 6/12: 13:00–16:00 PT

If you can share a time that works for your CTO/VP, I can loop in our VP, Rishi Malhotra, and our solutions engineer, Vivek Kulkarni. I attached a short discovery notes PDF and a one-pager on exec alignment topics for reference.

Thanks — happy to coordinate calendars.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Redwood Inference
